sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail as he has been implicated in connection with Crime No.717/2022 registered at P.S. Neemuch Kant,
District Neemuch for offence punishable under Section 420 and 34 of IPC.
His earlier bail application M.Cr.C. No.10826/2023 has been dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 05/06/2023.
The applicant is in jail since 26/01/2023.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

On due consideration of submissions, perusal of the case diary and looking to the material available against the applicant on record including the templates in which the applicant has been projected as CMD of the company along with his father who has claimed himself to be the CEO of the company, and also the fact that there is a defalcation of around Rs.1 Crore 50 Lakhs from 22 individuals, no case for grant of bail is made out.

M.Cr.C. is accordingly dismissed.
